memory_update.text: LOPE should remain the primary US-listed reference candidate for the online program enablement node because its filings directly disclose a full-stack university services model.
COUR should be tracked as an underfollowed platform-style exposure to university online degrees and credentials, but degree economics require more verification after the 2025 reporting change.
LRN is an adjacent virtual education operations candidate rather than a higher-ed OPM; include only in second-order screens focused on reusable online learning infrastructure and career pathways.

Many important OPM names are not currently clean US-listed equities: Academic Partnerships/Risepoint is private, Pearson sold its OPM business to Regent, and 2U went through Chapter 11, limiting public-market purity.

Key survival tests for this node are partner enrollment growth, marketing efficiency, student retention, regulatory pressure on revenue-share and third-party-servicer models, and customer concentration.

node: Online program enablement and university outsourcing
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around online program enablement and university outsourcing with a two-lane lens. The strongest direct public-market mapping is Grand Canyon Education, which discloses integrated services to university partners including marketing, recruitment, enrollment management, curriculum development, online course design, student retention support, technology infrastructure, and call-center support. Coursera is a smaller platform-style exposure through university degrees, certificates, and enterprise/institutional learning, but its OPM-like revenue sensitivity is less transparent after degrees were folded into Consumer reporting. Stride is an adjacent online-operations stack for K-12 and career learning rather than higher-ed OPM, useful as a second-order benchmark for outsourced virtual education infrastructure. Perdoceo is not an outsourced university services provider; it is included as a speculative shadow/operator analog because its online postsecondary operating capabilities, compliance exposure, and workforce-program focus may map to the same student-acquisition and retention chokepoints.
